features.name: total_active_segments
features.description: The total number of active relevant segments in the LED display.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a linear magnitude of active segments, allowing the SVM to easily separate sparse shapes from dense shapes.
features.formula: np.where(attribute_1 == '1', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_2 == '1', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_3 == '1', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_4 == '1', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_5 == '1', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_6 == '1', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_7 == '1', 1.0, 0.0)

features.name: horizontal_segments_active
features.description: The sum of active horizontal segments (top, middle, bottom).
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a linear projection of horizontal structural components, aiding the margin separation of shapes with flat tops or bottoms.

features.name: vertical_segments_active
features.description: The sum of active vertical segments (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right).
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates vertical structural components, helping the model distinguish tall, narrow shapes from wider ones.

features.name: right_vertical_active
features.description: The sum of active vertical segments on the right side.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates the right-side vertical segments, which is highly discriminative for certain right-aligned shapes.

features.name: left_vertical_active
features.description: The sum of active vertical segments on the left side.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates the left-side vertical segments, providing a direct linear feature for left-heavy shapes.

features.name: top_half_active
features.description: The sum of active segments in the upper half of the display.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes the activity in the upper half of the display, useful for separating top-heavy shapes.

features.name: bottom_half_active
features.description: The sum of active segments in the lower half of the display.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes the activity in the lower half of the display, useful for separating bottom-heavy shapes.

features.name: symmetry_horizontal_axis
features.description: The absolute difference in the number of active segments between the top and bottom halves.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures the imbalance between top and bottom halves, providing a continuous severity measure of vertical asymmetry.

features.name: symmetry_vertical_axis
features.description: The absolute difference in the number of active segments between the left and right sides.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures the imbalance between left and right sides, providing a continuous severity measure of horizontal asymmetry.

features.name: cross_intersection_active
features.description: An interaction term capturing the presence of the middle horizontal segment alongside vertical segments.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the interaction between the middle horizontal segment and all vertical segments, highlighting complex intersecting shapes.

features.name: visual_density_score
features.description: Semantic judgment of the visual density or compactness of the active segments, assessing how tightly clustered the lit segments are.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth normalized score representing the overall compactness, helping the SVM separate sparse from dense configurations.

features.name: shape_complexity_index
features.description: Semantic judgment of whether the active segments form a complex, intersecting shape rather than a simple line or curve.
features.expected_model_benefit: Offers a semantic assessment of shape intricacy, adding a non-linear structural dimension that becomes linearly separable in the SVM space.
